name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Faster friend video at home over a direct link. One download from a friend's server can stop well short of your line's speed (about 110 Mbps in testing), so 4K could buffer. Now, while your player watches one piece of a friend's video, your server already fetches the next three over the link at the same time, so playback gets the speed of several downloads (about 178 Mbps in the same test). Only the server watching needs 0.0.197; your friend doesn't have to update. Seeking drops what was fetched for the old spot; memory use is capped at 384 MB. Includes everything in 0.0.196.
